name: H’awouahoua
body:
H’awouahoua
CR 6

This horrific humanoid seems almost sewn together from an array of misshapen animal parts fused together, crowned with a nest of serpents in place of hair and draped in a shabby patchwork coat.

XP 2,400
CE Medium outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+2 Dex, +7 natural)
hp 67 (7 HD; 7d10+28)
Fort +9, Ref +4, Will +7
Defensive Abilities chimeric anatomy, snapping snakes; DR 10/cold iron or good; Immune electricity, fire, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee claw +12 (1d6+5 plus grab), hair of snakes +12 (1d4+5 piercing plus patchwork venom), gore +12 (1d4+3 piercing)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 feet with hair of snakes)
Special Attacks chimeric charge, fiery gaze

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 14, Con 19, Int 11, Wis 15, Cha 19
Base Atk +8; CMB +16 (+20 grapple); CMD 19 (21 vs. bull rush)
Feats Ability Focus (fiery gaze), Blind-Fight, Lunge, Step Up
Skills Craft (tailoring) +10, Bluff +14, Intimidate +14, Knowledge (Planes) +10, Stealth +12
Languages Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic, telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Chimeric Anatomy (Ex)

Because its vital organs are all misplaced, the h’awouahoua has a 50% chance to treat any critical hit as a normal hit and precision-based damage is halved against it.

Chimeric Charge (Ex)

When the h’awouahoua hits with a charge attack, as a free action it can make a combat maneuver check to bull rush the same target. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target. If the target has Dexterity damage from the h’awouahoua’s patchwork venom, the target also falls prone on a successful combat maneuver check.

Fiery Gaze (Su)

5d6 fire damage, 30 feet, Reflect DC 18 negates.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Patchwork Venom (Ex)

Hair of snakes—injury; save Fort DC 16; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d4+1 Dex; cure 1 save.

Snapping Snakes (Ex)

When an opponent within 10 feet confirms a critical hit against the h’awouahoua, as an immediate action it can attack that creature with its hair of snakes.

Soul Collector (Su)

After defeating a foe the h’awouahoua spends 1 minute flaying their victim (alive or dead) and adding its skin to their pelt. The souls of those whose skin is sewn into the h’awouahoua’s coat are bound to those mortal remains. The h’awouahoua uses them to power its supernatural abilities, and also trades them to other fiends for goods and services. They regularly traffic souls to night hags. When a soul leaves the h’awouahoua’s possession, the skin to which it was bound falls away from the coat and crumbles to dust. Any attempt to restore life to a body whose soul is trapped in a h’awouahoua’s coat requires a DC 18 caster level check. Failure causes the spell to be wasted without effect, while success causes a path of the h’awouahoua’s coat to crumble to dust and returns the creature to life as normal.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Abyss)
Organization solitary or kludge (3-5)
Treasure standard

This fiend is a chimeric collection of animal parts fused together in a vaguely humanoid form, mostly hidden under a draping patchwork coat. Its torso is like a turtle, complete with a hard shell. It is bipedal, standing on one cloven-hoofed goat leg, and the leg of a panther, with its body a mongrel mix of half a dozen beasts and vermin, with its apish head crowned with writhing serpents.

The h’awouahoua flays its victims, sewing their skins into its grotesque coat and binding their souls to it while it feasts on their flesh and bones. It trades these souls with fiends and leaches their energies to power its own vile magics, the castoff skins crumbling to dust if the soul is freed.
